description: Formalize-first refutation of a substrate-fixed real-x q-Bessel sinh(x·sinh η) as a c_3 residue-A cross-anchor closed form. The proton/muon anchors differ by Δq₀≈1.28e-8 but c_3 differs ~2.9% (dc_3/dq₀≈4.66e6, the PR #1821 wall); any physical-scale x under-predicts the swing ≥2e4×, matching it needs x≈2.5e6. Closes the one open gate PR #2279 named; confirms its no-closure caution. docs/audits/2026-06-14-qbessel-c3-crossanchor-smoothness-refutation.md.
discipline: no fit (x pinned, K cancels); derive-or-refute; TIERED; c_3 cal-anchored; nothing wired
verdict: REFUTED (real x). A substrate-fixed real amplitude x in the bar-odd q-Bessel / Jacobi–Anger object sinh(x·sinh η) CANNOT reproduce the c_3 cross-anchor swing: the two anchors differ by Δq₀≈1.28e-8 while c_3 differs ~2.9%, so dc_3/dq₀≈4.66e6 — the PR #1821 smoothness wall. Pinning x at any physical brane-tower scale (1…117) under-predicts the swing by ≥2e4×; matching it needs x≈2.5e6 (argument ≈2.6e5), physically absurd. This CONFIRMS PR #2279's stated caution (no c_3 closure claimed) and is consistent with PR #1887 (fixed-ℓ swing-lock) and the Im(q) fibre-vs-observable rule: the q-Bessel is the right FIBRE language, not a real closed form c_3(q₀). Productive direction stays the fibre-level Q_β Habiro element (α_EM [2]_q·(1−h²α) template). No fit; nothing wired; c_3 cal-anchored.
